title: Conditions of Service Under a Northgate Tire Center Package
content:
# Conditions of service

**Clause.** Services under a Northgate Tire Center package are performed at any Northgate Tire Center where the package says services are available at any club, and every work order records the odometer where the package requires it. Package services are performed only on a package whose status is installed. Where the package requires an active membership for service, package services are performed only while the membership on the tires' purchase has status active; a member whose membership has lapsed renews it before the Tire Center will rotate, repair, replace or adjust a tire, and the lapse does not shorten or extend any term of the package.

## The two gates

Both gates apply to every rotation, flat repair, road hazard replacement and treadwear adjustment, and both are read from the system's records before the work, not from the member's account of them.

1. **Package status.** The package referred to by its package reference number must show the status *installed*. A package awaiting installation, cancelled or retired takes no package service.
2. **Membership status.** The membership is the one named on the purchase on which the tires were bought; its status in the membership records must be *active*.

| Package status | Membership on the tires' purchase | Package service |
|---|---|---|
| installed | active | performed |
| installed | not active | not performed; a lapsed membership is renewed before the Tire Center will rotate, repair, replace or adjust a tire |
| not installed | active | not performed |
| not installed | not active | not performed |

## Points of judgement

- The membership that counts is the one on the tires' purchase, identified through that purchase record.
- A lapse in the membership does not shorten or extend any term of the package: the road hazard term, for instance, still runs from the installation date as before.
- Every package currently offered performs services at any Northgate Tire Center and records the odometer on every work order.
